title: transcritical-df-thinc-mood: double-flux THINC-BVD/MOOD/FCT solver for transcritical real-fluid interfaces
description: Python/NumPy finite-volume solver (double-flux method, THINC-BVD reconstruction, multilevel MOOD and full-vector DMP/FCT, Peng-Robinson equation of state) used to produce all results and figures of: S. El Oteby, R. Boukharfane, Sharp and Conservative Numerical Simulation of Transcritical Material Interfaces in Real-Fluid Multicomponent Flows. The script reproduce_all.sh regenerates every figure and table of the paper.
